consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1984-04-29 show at Nassau Coliseum was a high-energy performance with standout moments throughout. Jerry Garcia's guitar work received particular praise, and many reviewers highlighted the quality of the audience recording.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 20 reviews + 1.2 sentiment: The overwhelming enthusiasm for the performance and the quality of the recording led to a significant positive sentiment adjustment.
